entries.en: We've arrived back in Shibuya...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Why did Mika ask for me...?
So she could show you up.
Because you're a natural beauty.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I see... Then she was just[n]trying to be mean...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Is that why she was mad at me?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wait, so the real reason she requested[n]me was just so she could be mean...?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: If that's the case, I probably[n]deserved everything she did...
Cheer up.
Please don't cry.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm so pissed off!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Mika had to work super hard every[n]day to get where she is now.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: She worked out, watched her diet,[n]made friends with everyone...!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: She couldn't rely on connections[n]like I did... She didn't become a[n]model just for the heck of it.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Her resolve, her knowledge, her[n]fashion sense... They're all on a[n]totally different level from me!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Mika is amazing. Mika is... Mika is strong!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But me? I'm nothing!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Just thinking about that[n]makes me so angry... I feel[n]like I could explode!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: This whole time, I've just been[n]pretending to model. It was like[n]the clothes were wearing me...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I mean, that's what I always[n]thought being a model meant!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...But I was totally wrong.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: A real model draws out the beauty[n]of the clothes they wear... casts[n]a stunning magic on them...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: A real model is flexible,[n]beautiful... and strong.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well, I've had enough pretending!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I want to be a real model...!
You already are one.
Go get 'em, tiger.[clr 27]
What about your action movies...?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: No, I'm not even close... but that[n]just means I have room to grow!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Right! I'll give it my all!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Um...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I've moved on from that!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It still sounds cool... but I'll hold off until[n]I manage to become an actual model.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm gonna take the world by storm...[n]Just you watch, [fName]!
I sense a heightened[n]motivation from Ann...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Urghhh, I'm so mad!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: This is the perfect time for sweets![n]But no, I won't eat them!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I mean, I will... but not today![n]You eat some for me, [fName]!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Later!
